newsitem.title: USA: HELIONETICS UNIT EMERGES FROM BANKRUPTCY.
newsitem.headline: HELIONETICS UNIT EMERGES FROM BANKRUPTCY.

text.p: Helionetics Inc on Monday said its unit, Tri-Lite Inc, has had its reorganiation plan approved by a U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Santa Ana, Calif., and has emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
In a statement, the company said Tri-Lite has been profitable since September, and it expects revenues in calendar 1997 to range between $11 and $17 million.
Tri-Lite, a maker of lighting systems, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Feb. 1996. It is bringing regulatory filings up to date and expects its common stock to resume trading soon.
Helionetics now owns roughly 87.5 percent of Tri-Lite.
